# TPC-Havoc Q13_v9

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH customer_distribution AS (SELECT DISTINCT c_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c_count) AS custdist FROM (SELECT c_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS c_count FROM customer LEFT OUTER JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey AND NOT o_comment LIKE '%special%requests%' GROUP BY c_custkey) AS c_orders) SELECT c_count, custdist FROM customer_distribution ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC
```
